product.description:
Fifty Famous Stories Retold — James Baldwin

An illustrated American Book Company school reader collecting historical and legendary tales, including King Alfred and the Cakes, A Story of Robin Hood, and The Sword of Damocles. Green pictorial cloth hardcover with black-and-orange cover decoration.

Condition

Heavily worn antique hardcover with repairs and page damage. No dust jacket. Covers show substantial rubbing, fading, soiling and dark marks, with frayed spine ends and corners and small cloth losses. The front hinge has cloth reinforcement. Pencil writing and an ink mark appear on the endpaper. Pages are toned, spotted/stained and creased, with multiple tears and edge losses visible on preliminary pages. Page 99 has an old discolored tape repair; the facing illustration page has a tear at the top. Not inspected page by page; completeness of the text and illustrations and binding strength have not been fully verified. Please review all eight photographs.

Details

  • Title: Fifty Famous Stories Retold
  • Author: James Baldwin
  • Publisher: American Book Company, New York, Cincinnati and Chicago
  • Copyright 1896; actual printing date unconfirmed
  • Illustrated English-language cloth hardcover
  • Approximately 7¼ × 5 × ⅝ inches; book-only weight 9.6 oz

Included

One hardcover book. No dust jacket.

Packing & Shipping

Protected against moisture and packed in a rigid box with board and corner protection. Buyer-paid calculated USPS Media Mail shipping. Two-business-day handling. Returns accepted within 30 days; buyer pays return shipping.
